improvementsLog.title: Interactive Company & Tenant Switcher in Header Bar
improvementsLog.detail: Currently switching company requires opening the Database Manager modal. Adding an instant header pill '[Tenant: DEFAULT_TENANT] • [Company: MAIN_COMPANY ▾]' allows 1-click subsidiary switching without leaving the working document.
improvementsLog.marketBenchmark: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central global Company Badge & Quick Switcher

improvementsLog.title: Optimistic Concurrency Conflict Visual Merge Drawer
improvementsLog.detail: When an entity update encounters a 409 Conflict (_system_version mismatch), instead of a plain error toast, open a 2-column visual diff showing current DB values vs proposed changes with 1-click 'Overwrite' or 'Merge' choices.

improvementsLog.title: Zero-Downtime Hot Strategy Migration CLI
improvementsLog.detail: Provide 'bosc migrate-strategy --from shared_rls --to partitioned'. Allows SaaS providers to transition scaling tenants from multi-tenant shared tables to dedicated physical partitions with zero code rewrites.
improvementsLog.marketBenchmark: Surpasses Salesforce multi-tenant lock-in and AWS RDS manual sharding
